arrivalEssentials: Check whether the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card applies to your trip and complete it in advance if needed.
Choose between KLIA Ekspres speed and Grab door-to-door convenience before leaving arrivals.
Carry a little MYR or a functioning card for trains, food courts, and small purchases.
Sort mobile data early if you need ride-hailing, maps, or messaging immediately after landing.

options.bestFor: Fastest city transfer with predictable timing
options.notes: Direct to KL Sentral and easy to pair with local rail or short rides.
Best if you do not mind a slower trip and want the cheapest route in.

options.bestFor: Door-to-door travel with luggage or late arrival times
options.notes: Traffic into central Kuala Lumpur can change the timing significantly.

entryRequirements.passportValidity: Use a passport with at least 6 months validity remaining.
entryRequirements.visaSummary: Australian passport holders generally do not need a visa for short visits, but should confirm the currently permitted stay and trip purpose before departure.
entryRequirements.arrivalCardOrDeclaration: Check whether the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card is required for your trip and complete it before arrival when applicable.
entryRequirements.officialSourceNote: Review Malaysia immigration guidance and the official MDAC site close to travel.
importantNotes: Keep proof of onward travel and your accommodation details accessible.
Entry rules can differ for tourism, business meetings, and longer stays.

handyPhrases.context: Common polite greetings depending on time of day.
Useful everywhere from hotels to hawker stalls.

businessEtiquette.summary: Malaysian business settings often value courtesy, patience, and respectful relationship-building before pushing hard on decisions.
tips: Use polite forms of address and do not rush straight into blunt disagreement.
Be mindful that Friday schedules may differ in some contexts.
Dress neatly and keep your tone measured in first meetings.

foodAndPracticalities.tapWater: Filtered or bottled water is the safer default for visitors.
foodAndPracticalities.tipping: Tipping is not heavily expected, especially where service charges are already added.
foodAndPracticalities.dietaryNotes: Halal food is widely available; pork is common in some Chinese Malaysian settings, so ask if it matters for your diet.
foodAndPracticalities.commonFoodTips: Food courts and hawker centres are a practical way to try local dishes affordably and with good variety.

moneyAndPayments.cardAcceptance: Cards are common in malls, hotels, and many cafes, though smaller food vendors may still be cash-first.
moneyAndPayments.cashNotes: Keep some small notes for markets, local food spots, and backup transport.
moneyAndPayments.tipping: Rounding up or leaving a little extra is optional rather than expected.
roughCostExamples: Coffee or tea: about MYR 4 to 10
Simple hawker meal: about MYR 10 to 20
KLIA Ekspres to KL Sentral: about MYR 55

localTransportApps.name: Grab
localTransportApps.notes: The default app many visitors rely on for airport pickups and day-to-day travel.

localTransportApps.name: Moovit
localTransportApps.notes: Useful when combining KTM, LRT, MRT, and buses around Kuala Lumpur.

emergencyNumbers.label: Police, ambulance, and fire
notes: 999 is the standard emergency line for urgent assistance.
If calling from a mobile does not work smoothly, ask airport or hotel staff to assist.
